githubToken.label: GitHub access token
githubToken.hint: Optional. GitHub rate-limits anonymous calls to 60 per hour; a read-only personal access token raises that to 5000 so the update check never fails to read the repository version. The token is stored in this database only and is never sent back to the page. The OCTOPUS_GITHUB_PAT environment variable still works and has lower priority.

updateCheckEnabled.label: Automatic update check
updateCheckEnabled.hint: When enabled, the release for the current branch is polled from GitHub at the interval below; a newer version surfaces in System Info with one-click upgrade. Turning it off keeps the version readout but stops the polling.

updateCheckInterval.label: Update check interval (minutes)
updateCheckInterval.hint: Between 1 and 1440. Saving reschedules the task immediately - no restart needed. Anonymous GitHub calls are limited to 60 per hour, so keep this large unless an access token is set.

mail.title: Email Service (SMTP)
mail.desc: Delivery channel for registration codes and password resets. Leave empty to disable code sending. Password is stored masked and never echoed.

payment.title: Recharge & payment
payment.desc: Epay merchant parameters, exchange rate and bonus rules. All parameterized - fill in and they apply immediately.
payment.notifyHint: Leave empty to derive from the request. Set it explicitly behind reverse proxies or sub-path deployments.
payment.alipayHint: Website pay (RSA2). Keys accept raw base64 or PEM. Leave empty to disable this channel.
payment.stripeHint: Checkout sessions. Non-CNY currencies convert at the rate snapshot. The checkout.session.completed webhook credits the wallet.
payment.creemHint: Package-based top-up: create products in Creem, then map them here. Only matching amounts can be ordered; credits follow the package.
payment.bonusHint: When off, no amount receives a bonus.
payment.bonusRulesHint: Compact format 'minCNY:percent', comma separated, e.g. 100:5,500:10. Highest tier wins.
payment.withdrawHint: 0 means unlimited / no cooldown / no lock. Fresh revenue is not withdrawable during cooldown. Reseller revenue only.

form.name: Model Name
form.modeHint: Manual pins the selected member; the other strategies pick members automatically by their own dimension and switch on failure
form.presetHint: Apply recommended defaults for this mode; existing manual values are not overwritten automatically
form.retryCountHint: Total attempts per member, including the first request
form.retryIntervalHint: Wait time between attempts on the same member
form.nonStreamTimeoutHint: Maximum wait for a complete non-stream response
form.streamTimeoutHint: Maximum wait for the first valid stream event
form.cooldownHint: Time a member is paused after retries are exhausted
form.affinityHint: Time to keep the fallback member after its first successful request
form.autoAddNeedKeyword: Type a model or channel keyword first
form.priceMetricHint: Which price dimension the lowest-price and weighted-score strategies compare
form.metricWindowHint: Smoothing window (5-200) for latency and success metrics; larger is stabler, smaller reacts faster
form.scoreWeightHint: Weights are relative (0-100), any mix works; set 0 to leave a dimension uncustomized so it follows the system default (adjustable by admins on the settings page)
form.reliabilityFloorHint: Members below this success-rate percentage rank after healthy members; 0 follows the system default (70%)
form.request_timeout_secondsHint: Includes queueing, retries and streaming; default 600 seconds.
form.max_total_attemptsHint: Total attempts across all members; default 10.
form.max_wait_secondsHint: 0 disables waiting; requires positive queue capacity.
form.max_waiting_requestsHint: Default 0 (disabled). Full queue or wait expiry returns 429.
form.member_stream_idle_timeout_secondsHint: Abort if no new stream events arrive; default 60 seconds.

settings.title: Operational Reliability
settings.logRetentionHint: Keep request logs for 1-3650 days, default 7
settings.logStoreBodyHint: When off, only overview and usage are recorded
settings.logArchiveHint: Expired logs are written to the archive dir before deletion
settings.healthCheckHint: Sends real requests upstream, may incur cost
settings.webhookHint: http/https URL; leave empty for in-app only
settings.healthLatencyHint: Healthy probes slower than this fire a degraded alert; 0 disables
settings.backupEncryptHint: Encrypt backups with AES-256; passphrase comes from config.json backup.passphrase or OCTOPUS_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE
settings.alertDedupHint: Same channel, kind and reason alerts only once per window; 0 disables dedup
settings.alertChannelsHint: Multi-select; down/recovered/low-balance/quota alerts push through the chosen channels
settings.telegramBotTokenHint: Create a bot with @BotFather in Telegram to get the token; the bot must be able to message the target chat
settings.telegramChatIDHint: Target chat/channel ID (groups and channels start with -100); message the bot and query getUpdates to find it
settings.emailSMTPHint: Outbound SMTP host and port (usually 465 or 587)
settings.emailAccountHint: SMTP login username and password or app token
settings.emailFromToHint: Sender address and recipients; separate multiple recipients with commas
settings.breakerKeyThresholdHint: Consecutive errors on one upstream credential before it is tripped; 0 disables count-based tripping (auth and quota errors still trip instantly), default 5
settings.breakerKeyMinutesHint: Minutes the credential stays isolated after a count-based trip, default 5
settings.breakerKeyHardMinutesHint: Minutes the credential stays isolated when upstream reports an invalid key or exhausted quota, default 30
settings.breakerModelThresholdHint: Consecutive errors on one model within a channel before it is tripped; 0 disables count-based tripping, default 5
settings.breakerModelMinutesHint: Minutes the model stays isolated after a count-based trip, default 5
settings.breakerCoolAuthSecondsHint: Seconds this candidate is skipped for retries after an auth or quota error, default 60
settings.breakerCoolSoftSecondsHint: Seconds this candidate is skipped for retries after overload or model-missing errors, default 30
settings.alertFailStreakHint: Consecutive failed probes required to declare a channel down; suppresses single blips, default 5
settings.metricsAuthHint: When on, scraping /metrics requires a token; /healthz stays open as a liveness probe
settings.metricsTokenHint: Scrape with Authorization: Bearer <token> or ?token=<token>; the credential is never backed up — regenerate it after a restore
settings.metricsTokenRotated: Token rotated; the old one no longer works
settings.backupRemoteHint: Push the backup and checksum to WebDAV; credentials live in config.json backup.remote_*, failures raise alerts

hero.title: Every model provider, one aggregate gateway
hero.subtitle: Octopus sits between providers and your clients: aggregated channels, smart routing, usage-based billing, and full observability — all packed into a single self-hosted binary.

features.title: Everything in one console
features.subtitle: From onboarding to operations, managed in a single dashboard.
features.gatewayDesc: OpenAI Chat / Responses and Anthropic Messages translate between protocols; one key calls every model.
features.channelsDesc: A model name can back onto many channels, each with its own keys, protocol bits, and limits.
features.groupsDesc: A group is the model name clients see; 7 routing modes (priority, price, latency, success rate, composite score...) with automatic failover.
features.billingDesc: Reserve before the call, settle after, reconcile daily; text by token, images per image, video per video plus duration.
features.mediaDesc: Full image and video generation forwarding; job ownership is persisted and traceable; queries and cancels are free.
features.opsDesc: Live stats, log search, audit and rate limits, health probes and alerts, encrypted backups with off-site push.
features.accessDesc: Three roles — admin, reseller, user — with separate API keys and balances; registration with optional approval.
features.whiteLabelDesc: Configurable site name, description, and contact; Simplified / Traditional Chinese and English, light and dark themes.

media.title: Protocols & billing
media.subtitle: The inbound API always keeps the OpenAI shape; billing is per modality.
media.protocolsDesc: OpenAI Chat Completions · OpenAI Responses · Anthropic Messages · Image generation & edits · Video generation
media.textDesc: Chat and reasoning models billed by token.
media.imageDesc: Full forwarding for generations and edits (multi-image).
media.videoDesc: Create a task and poll for the result; job ownership is persisted and traceable.
media.videoPrice: Per-video base + per-second rate; resolution tiers optional

roles.title: Three roles, each scoped
roles.subtitle: Navigation is trimmed by role; you only see what you can use.
roles.adminDesc: Platform-wide: channels & grants, users, audit, rate limits, ops center, and settings
roles.resellerDesc: Your channels: connect upstreams, publish models, set prices, manage API keys and billing
